test_TexturesVertex_sample_textures: test TexturesVertex to sample vertex colors using barycentric coordinates and fragments from a mesh
test_TexturesAtlas_sample_textures: test TexturesAtlas to sample texture values from per-face texture atlases using rasterization fragments
test_TexturesUV_sample_textures: test TexturesUV to sample texture maps using UV coordinates and grid sampling on a mesh
test_pack_rectangles: test the pack_rectangles utility to compute optimal 2D bounding box packing for a list of rectangle sizes
test_pack_unique_rectangles: test pack_unique_rectangles to pack rectangles with unique identifiers into a minimal bounding box layout
